'''Eckerd''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] before being recruited into the [[Special Forces black ops program|black ops program]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] as part of the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] known as the [[Surgeons]]. The squad was later [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by the Republic on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berrun]] after it started hunting the families of enemy targets.

==Biography==
{{Quote|They were good soldiers. Far better than any of the others I've had under my command.|Sergeant Rusk, speaking about his first squad|audio=Rusk-GoodSoldiers.flac|<ref name="Bad Intel" />}}
[[File:Rusk_Salute.png|thumb|right|300px|Sergeant Fideltin Rusk, Eckerd's former commanding officer]]
A [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Bad Intel" /> Eckerd<ref name="Vanished">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Vanished}}</ref> served in a [[Surgeons|squad]] under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]]. Alongside fellow soldiers [[Karsim]] and [[Naja]], Eckerd participated in the squad's first [[Attack on an Imperial outpost|mission]], which was to free several [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war from an [[Imperial outpost (prison camp)|Imperial outpost]]. However, intelligence on the mission was incorrect, forcing the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] to fight through more enemy forces than it expected. Despite its disadvantage, the squad was able to rescue all of the prisoners and escape, albeit with heavy injuries, without a single [[Death/Legends|fatality]].<ref name="Bad Intel" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following that mission, Eckerd was among the squad members who were recruited into the [[Republic Special Forces Division]]'s [[Special Forces black ops program|black ops program]], and the squad was tasked with the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of Imperial leaders by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]]. The squad, which became known as the "Surgeons," soon began to go after its targets' families, in order to send a message to the Empire. However, their targeting of civilians eventually saw Eckerd and the others arrested by the Republic for war crimes; the squad readily confessed to their actions out of pride, and they were [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in a [[Berrun detention center|detention center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berrun]] as a result. Though the squad's members were young at the time of their arrest, the severity of their crimes meant they were sentenced to life in prison. Sergeant Rusk later sought out his former squadmates, curious as to why they had seemingly vanished, and was dismayed to discover their service history and resultant imprisonment.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Good soldiers know what acceptable targets are. This wouldn't have happened on my watch.|Sergeant Rusk, after learning the fate of his squadmates|audio=Rusk-AcceptableTargets.flac|<ref name="The Surgeons" />}}
A loyal soldier, Eckerd's [[Time/Legends|time]] in the Special Forces black ops program turned the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] into a killer who no longer respected the moral code of warfare. Eckerd was proud of the Surgeons' targeting of civilians, and confessed to the Republic upon the squad's arrest, believing that the unit's actions were just. Sergeant Rusk&mdash;who considered Eckerd and the others to be the best soldiers to ever serve under him&mdash;was disturbed to learn that his former squad mates had changed to the point that they targeted [[Gender/Legends|women]] and [[Youngling/Legends|children]].<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eckerd was mentioned by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Fideltin Rusk in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. While Rusk's squad is first mentioned in the conversation "Bad Intel,"<ref name="Bad Intel" /> Karsim, Naja, and Eckerd are not named until the conversation "Vanished."<ref name="Vanished" />
